tasks.title: Integrate existing tmux sessions
tasks.objective: Add a tmux Backend through public tmux integration surfaces without coupling native Runs to tmux internals.
tasks.outcome: Ctxmux clients can discover and attach to a selected existing tmux session while tmux remains its owner.
acceptance: The adapter uses the tmux executable or Control Mode rather than the private tmux socket protocol.
Disconnecting or terminating a ctxmux client does not terminate the tmux session.
Control Mode framing, escaped bytes, lag, teardown, and version differences fail explicitly and have transcript or real-session evidence.
Behavioral differences from native Runs are documented and capability-visible without forcing an abstract Backend framework first.

verification.proves: The adapter lifecycle, ownership, transcript, and real tmux session tests pass.
